verdict.rationale: Railway's homepage claims 'Private connections, public endpoints, SSL, and load balancing live from the moment you deploy' (railway-docs-4). Combined with its auto-config, no-new-tools positioning (railway-docs-1), this suggests private service-to-service connectivity with no VPC setup. The evidence is a single marketing line, though, with no detail on how internal traffic stays isolated from the public internet. Missing for 10: technical docs on the private networking mechanism (internal DNS, isolation guarantees, whether public exposure can be disabled per service), and independent or hands-on corroboration that internal traffic stays off the public internet.
